# UND Aerospace-Phoenix Accelerated Airline Pilot Training Program

> > Accelerated FAA Part 141 pilot training in Mesa, Arizona leading to airline pilot certification in 12 months.

UND Aerospace-Phoenix offers comprehensive accelerated flight training programs from private pilot through airline pilot certification. Located at Mesa Gateway Airport, the program combines intensive classroom and flight instruction with flexible scheduling options including a collegiate partnership with CGCC.

## Key Topics

- FAA Part 141 Certification
- Accelerated Pilot Training
- Private Pilot Certificate
- Commercial Pilot License

- Certified Flight Instructor (CFI)

## Accelerated Training Programs

- [Accelerated Pilot Training Program](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program): 12-month accelerated private pilot training with FAA Part 141 certification
- [Airline Pilot Training in Phoenix](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program/airline-pilot-training): ATP airline pilot training program in Phoenix, Arizona
- [Accelerated Private Pilot Training](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program/private-pilot): 2-month accelerated private pilot certification at Mesa Gateway Airport
- [Commercial Pilot Training in Mesa](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program/commercial-pilot-training): Commercial pilot certification at Mesa, Arizona flight training center
- [Instrument Rating Certification](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program/instrument-training): IFR instrument rating training for professional pilot qualification
- [Discovery Flight in Arizona](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program/discovery-flight): Introductory discovery flight experience at Mesa, Arizona flight school

## Certification & Pathways

- [Pathway to Becoming an Airline Pilot](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/pathway): Step-by-step pathway from private pilot to airline pilot certification
- [Become a Certified Flight Instructor](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/certified-flight-instructor): Comprehensive CFI training program at Mesa Gateway Airport
- [Certified Flight Instructor Training](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/commercial-pilot-training): CFI certification training program for professional flight instructors
- [How to Become a Commercial Pilot](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/commercial-pilot): Commercial pilot requirements and FAA certification guide
- [Certificates and Ratings](https://airlinepilot.training/certificates-and-ratings): FAA pilot certificates and ratings overview for all certification levels
- [What is a Private Pilot Certificate?](https://airlinepilot.training/certificates-and-ratings/private-pilot): Private pilot certificate requirements and eligibility for aviation careers

## Getting Started & Education

- [Become a Pilot](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot): Guide to becoming a professional pilot with FAA requirements checklist
- [Collegiate Program](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/collegiate-program): 2-year associate degree and pilot licenses through CGCC partnership
- [Part 141/61 Training](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/part-141-61-training): Comparison of FAA Part 141 vs Part 61 flight training regulations
- [Training Timeline](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program/training-timeline): Course duration and timeline for FAA Part 141 pilot certifications
- [Upcoming Classes](https://airlinepilot.training/accelerated-pilot-training-program/upcoming-classes): Class schedule and course dates for pilot certifications at UND Aerospace

## Career & Industry Insights

- [Career Opportunities with a Pilot License](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/career-opportunities): Pilot career paths including aerial survey, crop dusting, and banner towing
- [Is Now a Good Time to Become a Pilot?](https://airlinepilot.training/become-a-pilot/right-time): Industry insights on pilot shortage and current aviation career demand
